heading: Sliding Roof System

BE-82
BODY ELECTRICAL - SLIDING ROOF SYSTEM
SLIDING ROOF SYSTEM
TROUBLESHOOTING
Sliding roof cannot be closed and neverses in error for some reason.
1. Operate the corresponding switch continuously for 10 sec, or more from the starting point of the reverse motion.
2. This shifts it to the manual operatiion in which the jam protection system is prohibited. (with the ignition ON} 3. ln the manual operation, close the sliding roof completely and stop the motion. 4. The fully closed position will be detected by ECU.(lnitialization).
